# Validate inputs
    if not (isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) and isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) and isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray)):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays")
    if not (logp_with_result.ndim == 2 and logp_call_only.ndim == 2 and logp_no_call.ndim == 2):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must be 2D")
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if shape[0] == 0 or shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty")
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must have the same shape")
    if not (np.all(np.isfinite(logp_with_result)) and np.all(np.isfinite(logp_call_only)) and np.all(np.isfinite(logp_no_call))):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must be finite")
    if not (np.all(logp_with_result <= 0) and np.all(logp_call_only <= 0) and np.all(logp_no_call <= 0)):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a non-negative number, not a boolean")
    if tau_filter < 0 or not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be non-negative and finite")

    n_candidates, horizon = shape
    # Compute normalized weights (first future token t=0)
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Weighted negative log-probability losses (lower is better)
    L_plus = -np.sum(logp_with_result * norm_weights, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(logp_call_only * norm_weights, axis=1)
    L_empty = -np.sum(logp_no_call * norm_weights, axis=1)

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline (min of empty and call-only)
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)

    # Margin and keep decision
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter
